name: Tourist Visitor Visa (90 Days) / Visa-Free Entry

qualifying_event.description: Citizens of countries not on Ecuador's 'Special Regime' list (which includes China, Cuba, Egypt, India, Iran, Iraq, Nigeria, Pakistan, Venezuela, Vietnam, and others) may enter visa-free as tourists; Special Regime nationals must obtain this visa before travel.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Passport; proof of lawful means of subsistence; return/onward travel tickets.

requirements.blocker_text: Must prove lawful means of subsistence per Ministerial Agreement No. 70 (28 June 2024).
Outbound and return flight tickets or a travel itinerary are required.

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days within a year of first entry, renewable once for up to 90 additional days

sources.title: gob.ec (MREMH -- Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Human Mobility official portal) -- 90-Day Tourist Visa: Special Regime nationality list, lawful-means-of-subsistence and return-travel requirements, 90+90 day stay/extension rule

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Ecuador). Ecuador's baseline tourism policy is unusually open -- most nationalities enter visa-free; this visa applies specifically to a defined 'Special Regime' list of countries. No route to any further status.
